The '''''Outrider''''' was a [[YT-2400 light freighter]] owned by [[Dash Rendar]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Conversion Kit" /> that left the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Manual" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Note">{{FilmDate|IV|1|''Outrider''{{'s}} appearance}}</ref> Like other YT-2400 [[light freighter]]s, it was manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]];<ref name="Rebel Files" /> could reach speeds of 800 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]; was equipped with two double [[laser turret]]s, [[concussion missile launcher]]s, and a class 2 [[hyperdrive]];<ref name="Starfighters" /> and measured 18.65 [[meter]]s.<ref name="Manual" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mos_Eisley.png|thumb|left|The ''Outrider'' leaving Mos Eisley in the ''A New Hope'' Special Edition]]
The ''Outrider'' was first introduced to the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[YT-1300 Millennium Falcon Owners' Workshop Manual]]'', written by [[Ryder Windham]].<ref name="Manual" /> It was originally created for the [[1996]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] multimedia series ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' where it was the personal ship of [[Dash Rendar]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|starship|outrider|Outrider}}</ref> It was later included in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], where it could be seen leaving [[Mos Eisley]] shortly after [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] arrive in the spaceport.<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
